sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ADMISSION THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA

ORAL JUDGMENT Heard Sri.V.B.Siddaramaiah, learned counsel for the appellant, Sri.T.P.Malipatil, learned Additional Government Advocate for respondent No.1 and Sri.K.S.Bheemaiah, learned counsel for respondent No.2/beneficiary.
2. Appeal by the claimant in respect of 5 mango trees alone.
Admittedly, land of the claimant got acquired for the purpose Hemavathi Canal of Ambarapura Village.
Determination of the compensation by the Land Acquisition Officer, Reference Court and First Appellate Court are being questioned only with regard to the 5 mango trees by the claimant.

3. In a similar matter, where it reached this Court in MSA.No.94/2016, the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court NC: 2024:KHC:31693 has awarded compensation in a sum of Rs.1,01,055/- per mango tree by order dated 03.07.2023.

Same is not further challenged by respondents and said order has reached finality.
4.
In the case on hand, existence of mango trees is not in dispute.
But Sri.K.S.Bheemaiah, learned counsel contends that the Reference Court itself has noted that they were small mango trees.
But no contra evidence is placed on record to show whether the mango trees were fruit bearing mango trees or not.
5. Under such circumstances, the claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation in respect of 5 mango trees at the rate of Rs.1,01,055/- per mango tree with all consequential reliefs.
Appeal needs to be allowed to that extent.

6. Accordingly, the following:
Sri K Rajanna vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194515747/
2 ORDER (i) The appeal is allowed in part.
